reasoning_content: I accidentally used `description` again. The tool's schema requires `summary` instead of `description`. Let me re-run it.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
cd /tmp
rm -f cj.txt
HTML=$(curl -s --max-time 60 -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/)
CSRF=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -o "name=\"csrf-token\" content=\"[^\"]*\"" | sed "s/.*content=\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/")
curl -s --max-time 60 -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signin \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-CSRF-Token: $CSRF" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"admin@example.com\",\"password\":\"test\"}" \
  -o /tmp/signin.json -w "LOGIN_HTTP=%{http_code}\n"
echo "--- response (first 400 chars) ---"
head -c 400 /tmp/signin.json
echo
echo "--- session cookie present? ---"
grep -i "_zammad_session" cj.txt | wc -l
'
